svg.text: Casino sign - layout of the LED strips (to scale, dimensions in cm)
10 strips, 27 pieces, 238 LEDs in total. LED pitch 16.7 mm (60 LEDs per metre).
one strip, one piece per letter,

Numbers next to the pieces and inside the letter circles are LED counts. #a-b are LED indexes in the sketch.
The gaps between strips are drawn only for clarity: on the real sign the strips touch each other.
A letter group may be laid out behind its letter in any shape; the circle is only an illustration.
